lpStepsTitle: Three steps, nothing to set up
lpStepsSub: One photo is enough. Nothing to create, nothing to retype.
lpStepsDifferentiator: Unlike apps where you type every card yourself, here a photo is enough.
lpStep1Body: A photo of your sheet, a textbook page or a screenshot is enough.
lpStep2Body: The text is read and split into study cards. You see them all and can fix them before playing.
lpStep3Body: You move along a path step by step, earn XP and see what has not sunk in yet.
lpProductTitle: What you get after the scan
lpProductSub: A scanned sheet becomes a full path, not just a list of words.
lpProduct1Body: Up to 10 steps, one at a time. The green node is the one you can play: its icon means quiz, listening or writing. When the step is done, the node catches fire based on your score.
lpProduct2Body: The same sheet comes back as a quiz, as listening and as writing. You cannot just memorise the order of the answers.
lpProduct3Body: Every word you miss is kept aside. You replay only your mistakes, without redoing the whole sheet.
lpProblemTitle: Re-reading your notes is not revising them.
lpProblemBody: You read it three times, everything looks familiar, you assume you know it. On test day, nothing. Re-reading is passive: your brain recognises the text instead of retrieving it.
lpSolutionTitle: Here, you have to come up with the answer.
lpSolutionBody: Every game asks you a question and waits for your answer. That effort is what makes it stick, and it is far easier to start than another read-through.
lpBenefit1Body: The hardest part is getting going. One photo and the session has started.
lpBenefit2Body: A step takes a few minutes, on the bus or between two classes.
lpBenefit3Body: Each step score tells you what is solid and what needs another pass.
lpWhyTitle: Why ScanPlay instead of a generic deck
lpWhy1Title: It’s your notes, not someone else’s pack
lpWhy1Body: The game is generated from the sheet you photograph. No premade decks written by strangers for a syllabus that isn’t yours.
lpWhy2Title: No cards to prepare by hand
lpWhy2Body: You don’t retype words, cut flashcards, or import a spreadsheet. One photo is enough to start.
lpWhy3Title: You revise exactly what’s on the page
lpWhy3Body: Vocabulary, dates, definitions: what’s on your sheet becomes the game, not a generic topic chosen for you.
lpGameTitle: A reason to come back tomorrow
lpGameSub: ScanPlay borrows the mechanics of the games you already play.
lpGameXpBody: Ten XP per correct answer, and a level that climbs as you revise.
lpGameStreakBody: One day played, one more day on your streak. Milestones land at 3, 7 and 30 days.
lpGameAchBody: 44 achievements to unlock, a chest to open every day, and coins to spend on boosts.
lpRanksSub: Each colour tells you where you stand on a step.
lpRanksGlowBody: The node glows green while you play.

lpFaqSub: If the answer is not here, write to us.
lpFaq1A: Yes. Your first scan needs no account. With a free account you get two scans a day and your history is saved. Paid plans exist if you want to scan a lot more, with more accurate AI, but nothing forces you into them.
lpFaq2Q: Do I have to create an account?
lpFaq2A: Not to scan your first sheet. The free account is asked for when you start the games, so your progress is saved and you can find your sheets later.
lpFaq3Q: Which documents does it work with?
lpFaq3A: Images: a photo of your sheet, a textbook page, or a screenshot. Printed or neatly written text is recognised best. PDFs are not supported yet.
lpFaq4Q: What if the scan gets it wrong?
lpFaq4A: You see every card before playing. You can fix a word, delete one or add one, then start the path.
lpFaq5Q: Does it work on a phone?
lpFaq5A: ScanPlay is built for the phone first and installs straight from your browser like an app, with no store involved. It works on computers too.
lpFaq6A: Your sheets are tied to your account and are not public. What we keep is spelled out in the privacy policy.
lpFinalTitle: Your next revision starts with a photo.
lpFinalSub: Grab your sheet, scan it, play. It will take you less time than reading it one more time.
lpFooterTagline: ScanPlay turns your notes into revision games.
